title: help with train problem
body: Homework question: a train leaves the station at 9 am travelling at 60 km per hour. A second train leaves the same station at 10 am travelling at 80 km per hour on the same track. At what time does the second train catch up with the first? Answer: 1 pm.

title: interview prep
body: Given a list of meeting time-intervals, determine the minimum number of conference rooms required, so that no two meetings overlap in the same room! Sort by start time and use a min-heap of end times.
